podcast.title: Jim Gordon's Matricide
podcast.body: Jim Gordon, recognized for co-writing the influential song "Layla" with Eric Clapton, later committed a severe crime by killing his own mother with a hammer. "and then killed his mother with a hammer."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Murder of His Mother
podcast.body: Jim Gordon, the drummer for Derek and the Dominos on the song "Layla," murdered his mother using a hammer and a knife. He remains imprisoned for this crime. "Jim Gordon, the guy playing drums on that track, took a hammer and knife to his mother."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Members Joined Derek and the Dominos
xref.body: Following the dissolution of Cream, Eric Clapton formed Derek and the Dominos, incorporating members from Delaney and Bonnie. "he formed Derek and the Dominoes using members of Delaney and Bonnie and Blind Faith."
